tenders.title: RFQ for Laser Scanning Services for New Local Marketing Depot Project at Matla
tenders.tendering_authority: Kuwait National Petroleum Company (KNPC) via Larsen & Toubro Limited
tenders.scope_summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited is issuing a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for laser scanning services for the New Local Marketing Depot Project at Matla for the Kuwait National Petroleum Company. Vendors are required to submit their technical and commercial offers by the due date.
key_points: Project located at Matla, North Kuwait.
Focus on large-scale infrastructure projects in the hydrocarbon sector.
